description: Search Yu-Gi-Oh! trading card game (TCG) cards by name (fuzzy), card type, attribute, monster race/type, archetype, or level. Returns matching cards with names, types, descriptions, ATK/DEF, attributes, archetypes, images, and TCGplayer card prices.

name.description: Fuzzy card name match, e.g. "Dark Magician", "Blue-Eyes".

num.description: Number of results to return (default 20, max 50).

race.description: Monster type/race, e.g. 'Spellcaster', 'Dragon', 'Warrior'. For Spell/Trap, the property e.g. 'Continuous', 'Quick-Play'.

type.description: Card type, e.g. 'Effect Monster', 'Normal Monster', 'Spell Card', 'Trap Card', 'XYZ Monster'.

name: search_cards
title: Search Cards
